groups.title: Nuxt Directory Structure
groups.question: A new teammate asks why your Nuxt components have no import statements and where layouts go. Explain Nuxt's conventions.

followUps.Layouts and pages/ Convention: How do pages and layouts render?

evidence.text: Components, composables and utilities in specific folders are imported automatically.
You can use them without import statements.
You need to know which folders are scanned, or code silently does not resolve.
The pages folder creates routes from files.
The layouts folder holds shared page frames.
app.vue renders NuxtLayout and NuxtPage to show them.

groups.title: File-based Routing
groups.question: You are building product pages by id, docs pages at any depth and a settings section with tabs. Explain how Nuxt's file-based routing handles this.

followUps.Dynamic Routes and Catch-all Segments: How do [id].vue and [...slug].vue differ, and which wins when both could match?
followUps.Nested Routes with NuxtChild: How do nested routes render child pages?

evidence.text: [id].vue matches one dynamic segment.
[...slug].vue matches any number of segments.
More specific routes win over catch-all routes.
A folder plus a parent file with the same name creates nested routes.
The parent renders NuxtPage where the child page appears.
The parent keeps shared UI like tabs while the child changes.

notEnough: Only saying routes can be nested.

groups.title: Nuxt Rendering Modes
groups.question: Your Nuxt site has a marketing area, a blog and a logged-in dashboard, and some pages show hydration warnings. Explain the rendering modes and hydration.

followUps.SSR vs SSG vs SPA: Choosing the Right Mo: How would you choose a rendering mode for each area?

evidence.text: SSR renders each request on the server, which suits dynamic, SEO-relevant pages.
SSG builds static pages ahead of time, which suits content that rarely changes.
Client-only rendering suits private dashboards, set per route with routeRules.
Hydration attaches Vue to HTML rendered on the server.
The client's first render must match the server's HTML.
Things like dates, random values or browser-only APIs during render cause mismatches.

notEnough: Only saying hydration makes it interactive.

groups.title: Nuxt Configuration
groups.question: You need to add modules, keep secrets in config and set up a third-party library before the app starts. Explain nuxt.config and plugins.

followUps.nuxt.config.ts Structure and Layers: What does nuxt.config.ts control, and what are layers?

evidence.text: nuxt.config.ts configures modules, runtime config and build settings.
runtimeConfig holds values that can come from environment variables.
Layers let several projects share configuration and code.
Plugins run before the app mounts.
They can register libraries or provide global helpers.
Suffixes like .client or .server limit where a plugin runs.
